$description: THE ROLE tier - the thing a slot asks for (`wants: <role>`) and a component declares (`provides: <role>`). ONE home for the provides vocabulary (ADR-0017 write-once). Metas carry `provides: "<slug>"` as an ADDRESS into this file - never an inline definition. The address set is the FENCE: a thirteenth role is Dave's ruling (s252-D1), never a lane's drift. Co-providers of a role are its substitutes; `priority` (integer, compared only within one role, update-alternatives) orders them, `when` (a predicate, s251-D5) gates them; complements hang off the role as `with`, exclusions as `not-with` (s251-D3/D6). The `providers` lists here are the ADOPTED MEMBERSHIP from the v1 review page; their priority/when values are ILLUSTRATIVE until the 25-meta pass (s251-D12) authors them on the metas themselves, at which point the metas are canon and this file's provider lists are a cross-check, not a source. Structure adopted from the DESK research (notes/_subreports/2026-09-06-249-DESK-interchangeability.md): Debian virtual packages, WordNet synsets, ISO 25964 preferred terms.

$provenance.resolver: knowledge/_validate_roles_resolve.py (owed in the 25-meta pass) - an unknown slug refuses, loud and named

$extension: EXPECTED, by ruling only: input sub-roles when forms are authored (non-factory modes, s251-D7); media / identity for marketing pages; needs-attention only if Dave names that molecule.
$not-a-provider: template-* (12, consumers - they hold the wants list) · hero · hero-variants · footer · footer-doormat-lockup · image-block · video-player · qr-code · avatar · avatar-group · tags · payment-card-visual · card-header-lockup · account-card · EXAMPLE-button

headline-metric.axis: FFF: function "how big is it, and did it move?"
headline-metric.definition: One number the reader takes away, optionally with its movement. The tile a dashboard's top row is made of.

providers.when: default — label · value · delta · period, no series
a series exists to show (s247-D3 / DP-08: no series ⇒ not a KPI tile)
a target or performance band is the point, not the delta
the number is "money vs what is already scheduled"

status-surface.axis: FFF: function "how many, against what, and is that fine?"
status-surface.definition: A count or state against a threshold. The DESK example role, kept as named.

providers.when: one state, one dot + label, 2–4 cols
n × count as a key/value list, 6–12 cols
the threshold is a cap being spent against (limits-meter reading)
inline, attached to another element, count only

chart-panel.axis: FFF: function is the chart-intent word, gated by answers, not by the role
chart-panel.definition: A charted reading in a panel. ONE role for all fourteen charts: the five intent words (comparison · change-over-time · distribution · relationship · composition) already live on the answers axis (chart-intents.json, s251-D11), so they gate; the role only names the slot. Five roles named after the intents would duplicate that axis and break "three independent axes" (s251-D3). This is the call most worth striking if you disagree — see §14 call 1.

providers.when: comparison; stacked variant when composition across categories
composition, a centre total is meaningful
two measures in different units over one axis
inline scale, no axes — normally a complement of 01, not a panel

record-list.definition: Many records of one kind, one per row. Shape splits it: columns, cards, ledger lines, time-ordered.

providers.when: sort / filter / select / edit-in-place is required
the records are a ledger with a running balance
the records are issued documents to open / download
the records are future recurring instructions
time is the structure, records have happened

page-frame.axis: FFF: form dominates — the frame is chosen by navigation depth and job
page-frame.definition: The shell around everything. Seven providers, one per frame; only one can win, so not-with is implicit among co-providers (Debian: one-at-a-time facility).

providers.when: default for dashboards (the bento template composes it)
two peers on screen at once
marketing / servicing site with a mega-footer

page-title.axis: FFF: function "what am I looking at?"
page-title.definition: The band that names the page or a section of it. Providers differ by level, so when is the level.

providers.when: page level, with actions or tabs
page or screen level, app-only, no lock-up needed
section level, above one board / table / panel
a kicker alone is enough (rare; normally a part of the above)

wayfinding.axis: FFF: function "where am I, where can I go?"
wayfinding.definition: Navigation that is not the frame. Global, local, in-page and mobile are the when values.

providers.when: global, desktop, persistent column (pairs with app-shell-side-nav)
local — peer views in one context

action.definition: A trigger. Emphasis (primary / secondary / ghost) is a placement property, not a role — Material's emphasis axis, per the DESK page.

providers.when: space is tight and the glyph is universal
one main action plus a menu of related ones
the action is navigation inside running text
a row / grid of 4–8 shortcuts on an overview
a flow's primary + secondary pinned to the footer
marketing band, heading + support line + pair

arrangement.axis: FFF: form — these carry no content of their own
arrangement.definition: Containers and grids that hold other providers. The bento band itself is NOT here: its reflow / compress alternatives are owned by the band (s251-D14, rule 6b) and are not component-provided roles.

providers.when: default — container / stack / row / grid / twelve-column / split / measure
one of a set at a time

feedback.axis: FFF: function "the system is telling you something"
feedback.definition: Status from the system to the person: persistence and placement are the when. Includes the nothing-yet states.

providers.when: the RAG family in its four placements
a region has nothing to show
content is on its way, shape known
a task underway, full = done (meter's progress reading)

input.axis: Not in the first pass (s251-D12) — listed so the library is whole
input.definition: The person gives a value. Provider chosen by value type; this role is large and will want sub-roles when forms get authored — not now.

overlay.axis: Not in the first pass — listed so the library is whole
overlay.definition: Something on top of the page that the person must dismiss or answer.

providers.when: a message or side-task that needs an answer
show a thing, not ask a thing
